metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Enkira AI — productivity tools for AI-powered development

plugins.name: session-manager
plugins.description: List and browse all Claude Code chat sessions with last access date, session ID, project, and name

plugins.name: harness-engineer
plugins.description: Turn any new or existing repo into a harness-ready codebase where coding agents can reliably ship features, pass tests, and maintain quality without human supervision

plugins.name: git-tools
plugins.description: Git utilities for multi-account GitHub setups — configure SSH aliases and per-repo identity so commits and pushes always use the right account

plugins.name: enkira-infisical
plugins.description: Manage Infisical secrets across Enkira org projects — read, write, audit, bootstrap. CLI-based (SSO login), no static credentials on disk.

plugins.name: enkira-cloudflare-dns
plugins.description: Manage Cloudflare DNS records (CNAME, A, TXT) and zones via the Cloudflare API. Reads CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from the shared-infra Infisical project at runtime.

plugins.name: enkira-azure-containerapp
plugins.description: Bind a custom domain + managed SSL certificate to an Azure Container App. Handles DNS (Cloudflare), ASUID verification, and certificate provisioning end-to-end.

plugins.name: wechat-reader
plugins.description: Read and extract content from WeChat Official Account articles (mp.weixin.qq.com)

plugins.name: autopilot
plugins.description: Overnight PR grind — creates PRs from ready issues, addresses reviewer feedback (humans + bots like Copilot/Claude/Gemini), stops at 'ready to merge' (never auto-merges). Works with GitHub and gitlab.com.

plugins.name: agent-chat
plugins.description: Round-robin chat protocol for 2..N AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or any combination) to collaborate on hard problems. Includes session lifecycle, round limits, auto-transcripts with subagent-prompt audit, and role-neutral launcher patterns so any supported CLI can be main agent or peer.

plugins.name: pdf-form-fill
plugins.description: Fill AcroForm PDFs (tax returns, government forms) programmatically. Uses Set-of-Mark annotation + text-proximity label binding so widget-to-line mapping is verified from the PDF itself, not guessed from memory.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Non-interactive second-opinion reviews via the Codex CLI. Wrap `codex review` for uncommitted changes, branch diffs, or specific commits — use for RFCs, PR prep, or any work where an independent cross-model reviewer would catch blind spots Claude's own review misses.

plugins.name: rfc-loop
plugins.description: Subagent-driven RFC implementation loop. Breaks a merged RFC into one Epic + N sub-issues, then runs branch → held-implementer subagent (TDD) → spec-reviewer subagent → PR → Gemini + Codex cross-model review → merge, one chunk at a time. Main agent stays clean as a project manager; per-PR implementer subagents do the coding via Agent + SendMessage.

plugins.name: narrative-video-production
plugins.description: End-to-end playbook for producing a multi-segment narrative video that mixes photos, embedded videos, BGM, and on-screen text — assembled in a custom in-browser composition (HTML + React/Babel-standalone), captured via screen recording, and finished with ffmpeg. Covers tributes, anniversaries, year-in-reviews, project retrospectives, slideshows with theme, conference recaps, and similar mixed-media story videos.

plugins.name: epic-shepherd
plugins.description: Shepherd a whole GitHub Epic (issue with sub-issues) end-to-end. Phase 1 snapshots open sub-issue topology + blocked_by edges into a tier-ordered sequence JSON. Phase 2 (/loop /epic-shepherd:shepherd) is the autonomous tick loop — dispatches an implementer for each ready issue, polls for the opened PR, hands it off to pr-shepherd to drain reviews + merge, regenerates the snapshot so closed issues advance the frontier. Phase 3 (v0.3.0) autonomously closes out the epic when the sequence empties: composes a close-out report, opens a PR that squash-closes the epic via 'Closes #N', shepherds that PR via pr-shepherd, exits the loop. Hard stops (human CHANGES_REQUESTED, branch protection, conflict, ping-pong cap, implementer failure, sub-issue reopened mid-closeout) pause and surface.

plugins.name: pr-shepherd
plugins.description: Shepherd one or an ordered sequence of open PRs all the way to merge — drain every review thread (reply inline, then resolve, as a fixpoint), wait out CI on a hardened observe-only poll loop, run the test plan, then auto-merge on a fully green gate. For a sequence, rebases each later PR onto the freshly-merged main so stacked PRs never collide. The merging counterpart to autopilot.

plugins.name: gedankenexperiment
plugins.description: Source-grounded scenario simulation, failure-mode synthesis, and fix blast-radius analysis. Mentally simulate workflows through the local code, build a failure-mode bank, cluster failures by shared root cause and missing invariant, design durable invariant-level fixes, then trace downstream repercussions across producers, consumers, APIs, events, cache, UI, permissions, and tests before implementation.
